title: AXT adapter protocol
description: The lines between the conformance runner and an adapter, as spec/conformance.md, sections 4 to 6, defines them: each line is a request of the runner or an answer of the adapter. The input of each operation is input.<op>, its result result.<op>. CC0 1.0.

request.description: A line from the runner to the adapter (spec/conformance.md, section 6).

answer.description: A line from the adapter to the runner (spec/conformance.md, section 6).

format.description: The version of the vector file format.

hello_answer.description: The adapter's answer to hello: the name of its library and the categories that library implements (spec/conformance.md, section 2.2).

vector_request.description: A request for one vector: its id, its operation and its input, never its expected result. The input of each operation is in its definition operation.<op>.

output_answer.description: The result of a vector. Its form for each operation is result.<op>, which the runner checks with the operation of the request.

unsupported_answer.description: An adapter that cannot perform the operation; the vector fails.

failure_answer.description: An adapter that failed for a fault of its own; the vector fails.

result.description: A result of spec/conformance.md, section 4: accept with a value, reject with an error, or the results of the steps of a session.

error.description: The error code: a code of spec/protocol.md, section 8.2, a reason of a DECLINE, or a code of spec/conformance.md, section 4.2.

note.description: Why, for people; the runner does not compare it.

field.description: For VALUE_INVALID, the path of the value that breaks a rule (spec/metadata.md, section 7.2), or null.
